QuestInfo.name: [PC Cafe] The Thunder Gourd
QuestInfo.0: Maple World hums with energy because of Tempest. To take advantage of that energy, Cassandra has a request for you. \n
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the #bThunder Gourd#k that Cassandra gave you for #r30 minutes#k to let it fill up with the mysterious power of the tempestuous wind. Then bring it to Cassandra. #bRemember, if you log out before it's full, the gourd will disappear.#k
QuestInfo.2: You filled the Thunder Gourd for Cassandra and received Tempest Coins in exchange.

0.0: #b#h0##k, Maple World is currently celebrating the arrival of Tempest. It's wonderful! I think I've printed thousands of pamphlets already, and there's nothing I love more than collating! But I need your help with something.

yes.0: I want to fill the energy of Tempest into this #b#i3994574# #t3994574##k so I can keep it for my records. All you have to do is #rstay logged in for 30 minutes#k and it'll fill right up. It'll transform into a #r#i3994575##t3994575##k, which you can bring to me. #bJust remember, if you log out before the gourd is full, it'll disappear!#k You'll have to start over!

no.0: Let me know if you change your mind.

default.0: That gourd is certainly NOT full yet.
